subject: Residency attestation & network snapshot request — VPC operator/keystore paths
messages:
From: compliance@aurorahealthtech.com
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@veridian.io
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: EU hosting + private connectivity details

Hi Michael —

Aurora is working through the CAIQ/SIG intake for our EU deployment. We need to confirm a few items tied to the contract milestone next week:

1) Concrete confirmation that production inference traffic for our EU tenant is served from EU-only nodes (no cross-border egress). Please include the latest node inventory and mapping to regions.
2) VPC topology snapshot showing peering/private link endpoints and route table entries for the EU plane.
3) Keystore operator list: who has access to operator accounts for keystore rotation (human and system identities).
4) Any SOC 2 artifact references relevant to network segregation and key management (can be pointers to our evidence repo).

Can you send the minimal evidence packet and a target time for a short walkthrough (30m) with our security ops team? Ideally we get this before Friday so we can keep the procurement window open.

Thanks,
Aisha Clarke
Senior Compliance Manager
Aurora HealthTech
compliance@aurorahealthtech.com
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: compliance@aurorahealthtech.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: EU hosting + private connectivity details

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you asked for; see plan below and attached snaps.

What we attached:
- vpc_snapshot_20261109.pdf — static topology for the EU production plane (subnets, peering links, PrivateLink endpoints).
- residency_matrix_eu_nodes.xlsx — node inventory with node IDs, region tags, and hostnames.
- keystore_operator_manifest_20261118.csv — operator roster (roles masked where appropriate) and last-access timestamps.

Quick notes / clarifications:
- The EU tenant is served from EU-only AZs and the route table for those subnets has no internet-facing egress routes for inference traffic. We do maintain global control-plane coordination, but data path and KV cache are pinned to the eu cluster for your tenant.
- For SOC 2 artifacts we host a scoped evidence bundle in our internal drive — link below — with the network architecture section and KMS control excerpts. If you need a signed SOC 2 report, let us know and we can initiate the formal delivery via your vendor portal.

Can we schedule a 30 minute walkthrough on Friday 13:00–13:30 CET (04:00–04:30 PT)? Irene will be on the call for the keystore operator questions and Marissa can cover peering/fallback.

If you specifically need the full SIG JSON export vs. a condensed CAIQ index, tell us which and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security & Deployments
Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com
[attachment: vpc_snapshot_20261109.pdf]
[attachment: residency_matrix_eu_nodes.xlsx]
[attachment: keystore_operator_manifest_20261118.csv]
From: compliance@aurorahealthtech.com
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: security_ops@veridian.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: EU hosting + private connectivity details

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 11:05 AM, michael_grant@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Aisha —
>
> Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you asked for; see plan below and attached snaps.

Thanks Michael — the attachments look helpful. A couple follow-ups before the walkthrough:

- For the keystore manifest: do you distinguish between operator identities that are human vs. service principals? We need the separation and last-rotation proofs.
- We also need a trace of how cross-account peering is restricted: specifically, any IAM policies or security groups that explicitly deny routing from non-EU accounts. A config snippet or route table export is fine.
- Finally, can you provide the retention policy for token-level request logs that pass through the EU plane (token retention and redaction rules)?

If you can attach those three items to the evidence repo prior to the call that would be ideal. If any part is sensitive we can accept redacted exports or a short readout during the meeting.

Regards,
Aisha Clarke
Senior Compliance Manager
Aurora HealthTech
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: compliance@aurorahealthtech.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: EU hosting + private connectivity details

Aisha —

Appreciate the follow-ups. Per our notes from today’s walkthrough (attached recording link) here’s the deliverable snapshot we uploaded to the evidence folder: 

1) keystore_operator_manifest_20261118.csv — now includes a column "identity_type" with values human/service-principal and a redaction flag where full principal identifiers are sensitive. We also exported last-rotation timestamps for each key.
2) route_table_export_eu_subnets.txt — a route table export showing explicit peering entries and a deny route for 0.0.0.0/0 on the tenant inference subnets. (See attachment stub).
3) token_retention_policy_excerpt.txt — short excerpt summarizing retention window (30 days for request-level metadata, 0 tokens stored beyond immediate inference processing except aggregated metrics) and redaction controls.

Attachments uploaded to evidence folder (links above): vpc_snapshot_20261109.pdf, residency_matrix_eu_nodes.xlsx, keystore_operator_manifest_20261118.csv, route_table_export_eu_subnets.txt, token_retention_policy_excerpt.txt.

Conclusions from call: production inference path for your EU tenant is confined to EU-only nodes. Control-plane ops require cross-region coordination but do not introduce user data egress. We invited your security ops to request any additional log exports during the 14-day evidence review window.

Next steps:
- You confirm that the uploaded artifacts meet your intake criteria and we’ll schedule the SOC2 delivery (if requested) through your vendor portal.
- If you want the full SIG JSON export, reply with the fields you want included and we’ll produce a scoped export.

Thanks — closing the loop for now. Irene will remain on the thread for follow-up questions on key rotation cadence.

Best regards,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security & Deployments
Redwood Inference
https://redwood-drive.internal/aurora/evidence/DR-8890
